entities.summary: Le Lido is a musical theatre venue located on the Champs-Élysées in Paris, France. It opened in 1946 at 78 Avenue des Champs-Élysées and moved to its current location in 1977. Until its purchase by Accor in 2021, it was known for its exotic cabaret and burlesque shows including dancers, singers, and other performers. Famous names have performed there including: Edith Piaf, Siegfried and Roy, Hervé Vilard, Sylvie Vartan, Ray Vasquez, Renee Victor, Johnny Hallyday, Maurice Chevalier, Marlene Dietrich, Eartha Kitt, Josephine Baker, Kessler Twins, Elton John, Laurel & Hardy, Dalida, Shirley MacLaine, Mitzi Gaynor, Juliet Prowse, Sid Krofft, and Noël Coward.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent cabaret venue in Paris, Le Lido played a significant role in the development of French popular culture during the mid-20th century. With performances by numerous famous artists, it helped shape the city's entertainment scene and contributed to its reputation as a hub for international talent.
